source.javascript: export function createAutocomplete(root){const input=root.querySelector("[data-autocomplete-input]");const list=root.querySelector("[data-autocomplete-list]");const status=root.querySelector("[data-autocomplete-status]");const form=root.querySelector("[data-autocomplete-form]");if(!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement)||!(list instanceof HTMLUListElement)||!(status instanceof HTMLElement))return{destroy(){}};const cities=["Lisbon","London","Los Angeles","San Francisco","San José","San Juan","São Paulo","Tokyo"];let matches=[];let activeIndex=-1;const close=()=>{list.hidden=true;input.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");input.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");activeIndex=-1;};const select=(value)=>{input.value=value;matches=[];close();status.textContent=`Selected ${value}.`;};const render=()=>{const query=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();matches=query?cities.filter(city=>city.toLowerCase().includes(query)):[];activeIndex=-1;list.replaceChildren();matches.forEach((city,index)=>{const option=document.createElement("li");option.className="c-autocomplete__option";option.id=`autocomplete-option-${index}`;option.dataset.index=String(index);option.setAttribute("role","option");option.setAttribute("aria-selected","false");option.textContent=city;list.append(option);});const hasMatches=matches.length>0;list.hidden=!hasMatches;input.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(hasMatches));input.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");status.textContent=hasMatches?`${matches.length} suggestion${matches.length===1?"":"s"} available.`:query?"No matching cities.":"Type to see matching cities.";};const setActive=(index)=>{activeIndex=(index+matches.length)%matches.length;list.querySelectorAll("[role=\"option\"]").forEach((option,optionIndex)=>{const selected=optionIndex===activeIndex;option.setAttribute("aria-selected",String(selected));});input.setAttribute("aria-activedescendant",`autocomplete-option-${activeIndex}`);};const onInput=()=>render();const onKeyDown=event=>{if(event.key==="ArrowDown"&&matches.length){event.preventDefault();setActive(activeIndex+1);}else if(event.key==="ArrowUp"&&matches.length){event.preventDefault();setActive(activeIndex-1);}else if(event.key==="Enter"){event.preventDefault();if(activeIndex>=0)select(matches[activeIndex]);}else if(event.key==="Escape"){matches=[];close();status.textContent="Suggestions closed.";}};const onListClick=event=>{const option=event.target.closest("[role=\"option\"]");if(option instanceof HTMLElement){const index=Number(option.dataset.index);if(Number.isInteger(index)&&matches[index])select(matches[index]);}};const onSubmit=event=>event.preventDefault();input.addEventListener("input",onInput);input.addEventListener("keydown",onKeyDown);list.addEventListener("click",onListClick);form?.addEventListener("submit",onSubmit);render();return{destroy(){input.removeEventListener("input",onInput);input.removeEventListener("keydown",onKeyDown);list.removeEventListener("click",onListClick);form?.removeEventListener("submit",onSubmit);}}}document.querySelectorAll("[data-component=\"autocomplete\"]").forEach(createAutocomplete);

title: Animate On Scroll
summary: A dependency-free progressive enhancement that reveals nonessential content as it enters a scrollable viewport.
overview: A native scroll viewport enhanced with IntersectionObserver so content remains readable without JavaScript and gains a restrained reveal as it enters view.

component.useWhen: Use animate on scroll for nonessential content that benefits from a gentle reveal while people browse a page or panel.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid scroll-triggered motion for critical instructions, dense reference content, or interfaces where every item must be immediately visible.

examples.title: Basic Animate On Scroll

source.html:
Scroll to explore

Release notes

Focus the panel and scroll to reveal each update with a small, purposeful entrance.

01 / Prepare

Make the first step clear

Lead with the smallest useful action so people know where to begin.

02 / Guide

Reveal context at the right time

Let supporting detail enter as it becomes relevant instead of competing with the current task.

03 / Confirm

Keep progress perceivable

Use motion as a quiet signal that the next piece of content has arrived.

04 / Finish

End with a useful next step

Give the final item enough space to be read without forcing a jump elsewhere.

source.javascript: export function createBlockUi(root){const button=root.querySelector("[data-toggle]"),content=root.querySelector("[data-content]"),status=root.querySelector("[data-status]");if(!button||!content)return{destroy(){}};const toggle=()=>{const disabled=button.getAttribute("aria-pressed")!=="true";button.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(disabled));button.textContent=disabled?"Enable content":"Disable content";content.classList.toggle("is-disabled",disabled);content.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(control=>{control.disabled=disabled;});if(status)status.textContent=disabled?"Content is disabled":"Content available";};button.addEventListener("click",toggle);return{destroy(){button.removeEventListener("click",toggle);}}}document.querySelectorAll("[data-component=\"block-ui\"]").forEach(createBlockUi);
